race.comment: BEAU STRADA (10) took a while to clear her maiden status last season, and was put aside after failing on a heavy track in June. Her best form has been on good surfaces, and she looked ready to rumble when winning a recent jump-out at Cranbourne earlier in this month. A wide gate is no help, but she could still have the edge over these. On top. SHE'S ELUSIVE (6) was put aside after a poor run on an unsuitable heavy track at Sale in July, and all of her best form has been on a firmer surface. She cops a wide draw, but was close up in a recent jump-out, and is worth including. EPIC CENTRE (4) will be peaking third up, and 2 of his 5 career wins have come at this stage of his prep. Each way. CUMBOOGLE (2) does not miss many meetings, and he will benefit from a 3kg claim here. On his best day, he is capable of a top 4 finish. QUEUE JUMPER (11) resumes from a spell, and will start from the pole position. Keep safe.
